name: ARP Scan
description: Crafts a ARP packet that collects Ip Addresses, Mac Addresses, Vendors
note: This script creates alot of traffic based on your subnet mask

name: Host Scan
description: Crafts one ARP packet that collects the Target Mac Addresse, Vendor
note: This script dosent make alot of traffic

name: ICMP Scan
description: Crafts a ICMP packet that collects the Subnet Ip Addresses, Mac Addresses, Vendors based on the ICMP reply
note: This script creates alot of traffic based on your subnet mask

name: Passive Scan
description: Sniffs the Network Ip Addresses, Mac Addresses, Vendors
note: This script collects Ip Addresses, Mac Addresses, Vendors passively with no traffic made

name: System info
description: Collects local info about your system
note: This script collects system Hostname, Ip Address, Mac Address

name: Vendor Scan
note: This script works without network connection unless you use a Ip Address as a target
